DECLARATIONOFZONINGLOTRESTRICTIONS Declaration (this “Declaration"), made as of this / day of a -y_, 2006, by and between 110-12 Third Avenue Realty Corp., a New York corporation, having an address c/o Toll Bros. Inc., 250 Gilbrator Road, Horsham, PA 19044, ("Lot 38 Owner"), and RRR 108 Third Avenue, LLC, a New York limited liability company , having an address at 37 West 57th Street, suite900, NewYork,NY 19019,("Lot 40 Owner")(Lot 38 Owner and Lot 40 Owner being herein collectively called “Declarants"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lot38Owneris theownerofcertainland,with thebuildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by the street address 110-112Third Avenue, designated as Lot 38 in Block 559 on the TaxMap of the City, County and State of New York as more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the“Lot 38 Land,”said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreerment, being herein called the “Lot 38 Building." and the Lot 38 Land and the Lot 38 Building being herein collectively called the “Lot 38 Premises"); WHEREAS, Lot 40 Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street addresses as 108 Third Avenue, New York, New York, designated as Lot 40 in Block 559 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein collectively called the "Lot 40 Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein called the “Lot 40 Building,”' and the Lot 40 Land and the Lot 40 Building being herein collectively called the"Lot 40 Premises"); WHEREAS, (i) by Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the“Original Declaration"), made by and between the Trustees of Grace and Hope Mission of Baltimore City, Inc.("Mission") and Lot 38 Owner, dated December August 3, 2005, and recorded at CRFN No. 2005000452011 in the Office of the City Register,NewYork County (the“City Register"),the tracts of land known as Tax Lots36 and 38inBlock559 on theTaxMapwere declared tobe “one zoning lot”as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork, effective as of December 15, 1961,as amended (the“Resolution"), and (i) by Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement (the “Original ZLDA"), made by and between Mission and Lot 38 Owner dated August 3, 2005,and recorded at CRFN No.2005000452012,executed in connection with the Original Declaration, certain rights were set forth with respect to the zoning lot created by the Original Declaration ("Original Zoning Lot"); WHEREAS, Declarants desire to create a single zoning lot (as defined in the Resolution) consisting of the Original Zoning Lot and the Lot 40 Land, (said land collectively referred to herein as the “Property");
